responsibility: Main hand-written implementation file for the SH backend’s target hooks and RTL code-generation logic. It owns SH-specific operand/address handling, prologue/epilogue and calling-convention support, assembly emission helpers, delay-slot and branch logic, scheduling and mode-switching hooks, T-bit/FPSCR/FPU state handling, FDPIC support, cost and expansion helpers, and other target-specific transformation routines that connect the option/header definitions and machine-description patterns to actual SH code generation.
same_name_distinction: Contains the SH backend’s hand-written C/C++ implementation of target hooks, helper routines, and reorg/expansion logic that interprets the configuration and options from sh.h and sh.opt and works alongside the RTL patterns in sh.md, rather than defining compile-time macros, declarative instruction patterns, or option-table entries.
